llm_hints:
- English B2B invoice template; all prose is generated from structured args.
- body="" — never write invoice prose by hand; the template's Jinja renders it from args.
- Hard-required: sender_name, sender_business, sender_address, sender_iban, customer_name, customer_address, invoice_number, invoice_date, service_short, amount, tax_percent.
- Optional but recommended: sender_bic, sender_bank, sender_tax_id, due_date, service_period_from/to.
name: Invoice (English)
description: English invoice with up to 5 line items and a single tax rate; configurable currency, no XML.
when_to_use: User has provided / can provide a service description and amount.
Recipient is a business or person paying for goods or services.
Sender is the user themselves (or their business) — outgoing invoice.
when_to_not_use: User says 'quote' / 'estimate' — use an offer template (TBD).
User wants to dispute / refuse an incoming invoice — needs a dispute letter.
Sender is in Germany and needs ZUGFeRD / E-Rechnung — use rechnung-de.
No clear amount or service named — gather details before drafting.
subject_template: Invoice {{ args.invoice_number or 'NEW' }}{% if args.service_short %} – {{ args.service_short }}{% endif %}
editor_notes:
Tax rate. Defaults to 0% — set the rate that applies in your jurisdiction (e.g. 20% UK VAT, 19% DE VAT, 8.25% Texas sales tax, 10% AU GST). For small-business / sole-trader thresholds (e.g. UK VAT registration threshold, US sales-tax nexus, German § 19 UStG) check whether you must even charge it.

Currency. Set Currency symbol to $ (default), £, €, A$, C$, NZ$, ₹, etc. Amounts use the international 1,234.56 format. For German-style 1.234,56 € use rechnung-de.

Invoice number. Assigned automatically from your Invoice series on save (Settings → Numbering).

More than 5 line items? Fork the template and add position_6_…, position_7_… analogously.
author: yorik-core

default_args.payment_text: Please transfer the total amount by the due date to the account shown below.

HVAC maintenance

Travel time + on-site assembly

ask_user_for_args.label: Customer address
ask_user_for_args.hint: Street + city + postal code. Multi-line ok.

ask_user_for_args.label: Customer number (optional)
ask_user_for_args.hint: Your customer number on their books (their internal ID for you).

ask_user_for_args.label: Service (short)
ask_user_for_args.hint: 1–3 words for the subject. e.g. "HVAC maintenance".

ask_user_for_args.label: Line items
ask_user_for_args.hint: At least one item. Rows can be added or removed freely.

item_schema.label: Description
item_schema.hint: Service or item. Multi-line ok — first line becomes the title, rest renders italic underneath.

item_schema.label: Unit
item_schema.hint: hr / ea / lot / day / kg / m / …

ask_user_for_args.label: Line 1 — Description
ask_user_for_args.hint: What was delivered / performed? Full text.

ask_user_for_args.label: Tax rate (%)
ask_user_for_args.hint: e.g. 20 (UK VAT), 19 (DE VAT), 8.25 (TX sales tax), 0 (no tax / small-business).

ask_user_for_args.label: Invoice number
ask_user_for_args.hint: Assigned automatically from the Invoice series on save.

ask_user_for_args.label: Company logo (URL or data: URL, optional)
ask_user_for_args.hint: URL to a PNG / SVG OR a data: URL. Shown at the top left of the invoice.

ask_user_for_args.label: Tax ID / VAT no.
ask_user_for_args.hint: e.g. UK VAT no., EU VAT-ID, US EIN.

ask_user_for_args.label: Tax / business number (optional)
ask_user_for_args.hint: Local tax / business registration number, if different from above.

ask_user_for_args.label: Business name (optional)
ask_user_for_args.hint: If you trade under a business name — leave blank otherwise.
